frame-accent-light.displayName: Frame Accent Light (links in dark frames)

display-xl.purpose: Hero H1 at xl viewport (3.25rem, 800, 1.08, tracking-tight). Gradient-text highlight lives at display level.

display-og.purpose: OG-card title (52px) in the light-brand OG route (src/app/og/[locale]/[slug]/route.tsx).

display-md.purpose: Hero sm step / largest section H2 step (48px, text-5xl).

headline-lg.purpose: Section H2 md step (36px, text-4xl, 700, tracking-tight).

ui.purpose: The workhorse size — nav links, table cells, buttons, footer (14px, text-sm; most-used size on the site).

chip-sm.purpose: Smallest badges — tier chips, terminal metadata (10px).

mono.purpose: Geist Mono in terminal mock and code blocks (12–14px, 1.6).

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting cards, buttons, chips. Navy-ink tinted, never colored.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Hover elevation for cards, buttons, FAQ items.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Dark product frames (terminal, dashboard) only — the page's deepest moments.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Buttons 0.15s; cards/borders/nav underline 0.2–0.25s. All state, no entrances.

motion.name: gradient-shimmer
motion.purpose: Animated hero gradient text; reduced-motion guarded.

motion.name: terminal-line-in
motion.purpose: Terminal mock lines entering; reduced-motion guarded.

motion.name: faq-reveal
motion.purpose: Details/summary answer entrance; no layout-property animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid confident-blue CTA; deepens and lifts on hover, no glow theater.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, #2563eb); color: #fff; padding: 10px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,37,64,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); transition: background 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(10,37,64,0.05), 0 6px 16px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White ground, hairline border, navy ink; border tints to accent on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #ffffff; color: #0a2540; padding: 10px 24px; border: 1px solid #e6ebf1; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #2563eb; background: #f6f9fc; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: White bordered card; shadow-sm at rest, blue-tinted border + shadow-md + 2px lift on hover.
components.html:
Per-agent budgets

Every unit of work is a recorded, replayable wake with exact cost-per-task.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e6ebf1; border-radius: 12px; padding: 20px 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,37,64,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: rgba(37,99,235,0.3); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(10,37,64,0.05), 0 6px 16px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-title { color: #0a2540; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { color: #425466; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0; }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Quiet hairline pill at 10–11px; interactive variant lifts 1px with a 4% blue wash.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; background: #ffffff; color: #425466; border: 1px solid #e6ebf1; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(37,99,235,0.35); background: rgba(37,99,235,0.04); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,37,64,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Muted slate link; 1px blue underline grows from center on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; color: #425466; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; text-decoration: none; padding: 8px 4px; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; bottom: 2px; left: 50%; right: 50%; height: 1px; background: #2563eb; transition: left 0.25s ease, right 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { left: 25%; right: 25%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: FAQ Accordion Item
components.description: Native details/summary card; open state tints border blue and lifts.
components.html:
Can agents see my passwords?

No. Credentials live in a vault agents can never see — injected at the egress proxy, never into the model.
components.css: .ds-faq { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e6ebf1; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(10,37,64,0.06), 0 1px 3px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); transition: border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-faq[open] { border-color: rgba(37,99,235,0.3); box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(10,37,64,0.05), 0 6px 16px rgba(10,37,64,0.08); } .ds-faq-q { color: #0a2540; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-faq-a { color: #425466; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; margin: 8px 0 0; }

components.name: Gradient Headline Highlight
components.description: The single color flourish: blue→indigo ramp clipped to headline key phrases.
components.html: Build your AI agent workforce by describing the team you want.
components.css: .ds-hero-h1 { color: #0a2540; font-size: 3rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.025em; margin: 0; } .ds-gradient-text { background: linear-gradient(105deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #2563eb 55%, #4f46e5 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent; color: transparent; }

components.name: Dark Product Frame (Terminal)
components.description: The signature produced product window: dark navy, traffic lights, mono type, shadow-lg — the only dark surface on the page.
components.html:
openlegion demo
$ openlegion create "a marketing agency"
> staffing 4 agents… done
components.css: .ds-terminal { background: #0d1526; border: 1px solid rgba(10,37,64,0.9); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 6px 12px rgba(10,37,64,0.06), 0 20px 44px rgba(10,37,64,0.12); color: #e2e8f0; } .ds-terminal-header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 14px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(226,232,240,0.08); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); } .ds-dot { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; display: inline-block; } .ds-terminal-title { margin-left: 8px; color: #8b8fa3; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; } .ds-terminal-body { padding: 16px; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-term-ok { color: #34d399; }

narrative.overview: This is the polished light enterprise SaaS page done without irony or concept: white ground, deep navy ink, one confident blue, alternating cool bands, and hairline rules everywhere structure is needed. The craft bar is Stripe, Linear, Notion, and Datadog/Vanta. The one theatrical inheritance from the prior dark site is deliberate: the product appears in dark produced frames (terminal mock, live dashboard window) that sit on the light page like screenshots of a real tool, because they are. The build is a restyle of a dark site whose class names and copy were preserved byte-identical (13 locales, SEO asset); legacy effect hooks — particles, orbs, glass shine, badge shimmer, dot grids, conic borders — remain in markup but are neutralized in CSS. Restraint here is not absence of capability; it is recorded refusal.
keyCharacteristics: White ground + #0a2540 navy ink + one blue accent; color never carries decoration, only meaning
Alternating #f6f9fc cool bands with 1px top hairlines set the section rhythm
Dark #0d1526 product frames are the only dark surfaces on the page
Gradient text (blue→indigo) is the single color flourish, reserved for headline highlights
Content is visible by default — no scroll-entrance animation anywhere
Section labels exist in the DOM but are sr-only: locked SEO copy, invisible kickers

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Every accent on the light page is the same blue family (#1d4ed8 / #2563eb / #3b82f6 by size and role). No second accent hue exists outside the gradient ramp and the functional green/red.

rules.name: The Framed Dark Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces appear only as produced product windows (.terminal, .dashboard-frame, .prose pre). The page itself is never dark; the frames are never light.

rules.name: The Tinted Wash Rule
rules.body: Colored backgrounds on the light page are always low-alpha washes of a token color (4–16% alpha), never new solid tints.

rules.name: The Full Ladder Rule
rules.body: The shipped size ladder is 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 20, 24, 30, 36, 48(=3rem), 52(=3.25rem), 60px. New surfaces pick from these literal steps; do not invent intermediate sizes or collapse the 13/14/15px reading tier into one.

rules.name: The Weight-Carries-Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: One family; hierarchy comes from weight (400 → 500 → 600 → 700 → 800) and size, never from a second typeface or from color alone.

rules.name: The Ink Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is a low-alpha layer of the navy ink. No colored/glowing shadows; the sole exception is the agent-pulse ring inside the dark dashboard mock, which is product-fixture behavior, not page chrome.

dos: Do keep all copy byte-identical to messages/<locale>.json — visible strings are a preserved SEO asset across 13 locales; redesigns restyle, only the launch truth pass rewrites.

Do render content visible by default; surviving motion is limited to hero gradient shimmer, terminal line entrances, dashboard tilt/live mock, and hover/focus transitions — all behind prefers-reduced-motion guards.
Do open every section with the 1px hairline and alternate #f6f9fc bands for rhythm.
Do tint shadows with navy ink (rgba(10,37,64,…)) and hovers with the blue at ≤35% alpha.
Do keep section labels in the DOM as sr-only — they are locked copy, not visible kickers.
Do preserve the accessibility floor: skip-nav, global :focus-visible outline, reduced-motion guards, semantic prose/tables, RTL/logical properties.
donts: Don't reactivate the neutralized legacy effects (particles, orbs, glass shine, badge shimmer, dot grid, conic borders, glow pulses on page chrome) — they are content: none/display: none by decision, not omission.
Don't introduce dark surfaces outside the product frames, or light chrome inside them.
Don't add visible kickers/eyebrows above headings; the pattern on this site is sr-only labels.
Don't use colored glows or halos as elevation; the only glow-like effect permitted is the agent-pulse fixture inside the dark mock.
Don't add scroll-entrance animation, a second accent hue, or a second typeface.
Don't invent pricing numbers, badges with glow treatments, or synthetic proof (testimonial avatars are flagged non-real in PRODUCT.md and are not on the shipped homepage).
